title: カプセル内視鏡になって、口から肛門まで旅してみた #Shorts
description:
口・鼻・肛門から人体の管に入って3Dで進むブラウザのアプリ「体内ダイブ」から。カプセル内視鏡になって、口から胃・小腸・大腸をぬけて肛門まで。

アプリ: https://sishiya.github.io/manabi-lab/body-dive/

しし屋 まなびラボ（ほかのアプリ）: https://sishiya.github.io/manabi-lab/

おもな出どころ: Betts ほか（2022）OpenStax『Anatomy and Physiology 2e』ほか（アプリのスタート画面「このアプリについて・おもな出どころ」）

音楽: プログラムで合成したオリジナルの音です。

#人体 #消化 #まなびラボ

en.title: I Became a Capsule Endoscope and Traveled from Mouth to Anus #Shorts
en.description:
From "Body Dive", a browser app where you enter the tubes of the human body through the mouth, nose or anus and travel through them in 3D. As a capsule endoscope, from the mouth through the stomach and intestines to the anus.

App (on-screen text in Japanese for now): https://sishiya.github.io/manabi-lab/body-dive/

Shishiya Manabi Lab (more apps): https://sishiya.github.io/manabi-lab/

Main source: Betts et al. (2022) OpenStax, Anatomy and Physiology 2e, and others (listed in the app's start screen, in Japanese)

Music: original sounds synthesized by code.

#HumanBody #Digestion
